name: My Dragon Island
desc:
🐉Welcome to Grow a Dragon!

Ready to grow a legendary dragon collection? Buy eggs from the conveyor belt, hatch them, feed them, and cash in the earnings. Show off rare dragons with friends, have fun!

[ How to Play]
🥚 Buy & hatch eggs
💸 Collect earnings from dragons
🍅 Grow crops and collect profits
🔓 Upgrade, decorate, and rebirth to unlock more!

Your dragons keep growing and earning while you're offline ⭐
